label: Ordered-love reading (q.20 a.2 ad 3): GOD_4 wills a non-rational effect's esse as ordered to others
paraphrase: Analyst formulation of the q.20 a.2 ad 3 ordered-love reading (irrational creatures are loved as it were with love of desire, as ordered to rational creatures and to God); attribution deferred. For every GOD_4 g with will and every distinct, non-rational x in act in esse whose esse g causes, g wills x's being in esse as ordered to some y that is rational or is g. It neither asserts nor denies that g also wills that good to x as recipient, so it is compatible with CausalExistenceWilling a94c5dfc (checked witness). Weak version of the unattributed strong exclusive variant 1dd68893. Rational is a primitive predicate here. OPEN.
